name: integrity-hash-endianness
title: Hashes must not be endian-reversed in integrity compare/display
description: CRC16/CRC32 stored values honor the panel endian toggle, but MD5/SHA digests are byte sequences with no integer endianness. The panels unconditionally reverse stored/expected bytes when endian=LE, so byte-perfect hash matches report Mismatch and Auto fix/Fix all overwrite the correct stored digest with a reversed one. Thread isChecksumAlgorithm so only checksums honor the endian toggle while hashes always use natural byte order.
